How to install Software ROMs Each Software ROM is labeled with a Location Number shown on it ( NX Shaded Portion illustrated below), which indicates the corresponding location on the P.C. Board where it should be installed. MDS-SC “Label on, Software ROM) SSS “VS.SOCCER” contains 6 Software ROMs and 1 Custom IC, which have location numbers, 1A or 6A, 1B or 6B, 1C or 6C, 1D or 6D, 2A or 8A, 2B or 8B and 2F or 8F. Each ROM and IC must be mounted into the proper IC Socket. For VS.OUAL SYSTEM (two monitors): if “VS.SOCCER” is to be installed in main (left) side of cabinet, then EPROMs and Custom IC should use locations 1A, 1B, 1C. 1D, 2A, 2B ano 2F. For sub ‘right) side, use locations 6A, 6B, 6C, 6D, 8A. 8B and 8F.
